english.meaning: a person or thing of unclear meaning, possibly a slow-moving person
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: I don’t know. Two slowpokes walked over and saw a boklok.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔知啊。兩個磨碌行去見到有一個bok6lok1。
